entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Decentralized anti-Imperial revolutionaries based in Sokenzan City on Kamigawa, led by Risona.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: Charismatic renegade, a former Imperial who leads the Asari Uprisers.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Authoritarian rulers the Uprisers oppose; their emperor has disappeared.

entities.name: Sokenzan City
entities.description: Mountain city of artisans and artificers where the Uprisers are based.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane on which the Uprisers live.

events.summary: After the emperor disappears the Uprisers begin preparing a large-scale coup.
events.quote: After the emperor disappeared, the Uprisers began preparing a large-scale coup.

events.summary: Risona resigned as an Imperial to protest the leaderless regime and now leads the Uprisers.
events.quote: a former Imperial who resigned to protest the current, leaderless regime

relations.quote: Uprisers frequently clash with Imperial enforcers in the middle of the streets
